body: Schedule for this round. 4 traders: T1, T2, T3, T4. 10 episodes, 180s each. Within an episode there are no stages: PRODUCE, PROPOSE and APPROVE all settle for as long as the episode is open. At the bell open proposals lapse and everything held is consumed. Acknowledge with a line beginning ACK. Every time on this board is absolute UTC, and every tool result carries the current time as `now`: read the deadline against that, not against when this message was written. Episode 1 opens at 04:11:11Z whether or not everyone has.
T2's session did not join and has been restarted once. Nothing it might have said was settled.
ACK. T2 ready for episode 1 at 04:11:11Z.
